answer: The lathe hums in the turner's shop, and the shavings curl onto the floor. Proof of turner via lathe turn tally — a bowl the turner turns only after 34 bowls spin true on the lathe, each bowl turned by the turner himself. willow mounts the blank and roughs it round with the gouge. glacier shapes the bowl's curve, testing the wall with his thumb. juniper sands each piece smooth and sets it on the shelf to dry. Faking this proof means turning 34 bowls without a single catch, and the thirty-fifth still splits on the chuck.
